items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: I think they picked her up in San Francisco.

ctx.x: -- and (unintelligible). And Lily on several Sacred Concerts Greenwood?

Lily was out of -- I think they picked her up in San Francisco. She was singing in that -- it was that place downstairs, was kind of cellar place up in San Francisco. She did quite well too for a while. As I say, they come and they go. They don't -- the only one that stayed was Ivy. She stayed forever. But most of the rest of them come and go.
What do you think of Ray Nance's singing?
